# Wiss

> AI-native accounting and advisory firm serving growth companies with comprehensive tax, audit, advisory, and technology-enabled accounting solutions.

Wiss & Company is a full-service CPA firm founded in 1969, specializing in technology-enabled accounting for growth companies. The firm combines traditional accounting expertise with AI-powered solutions and offers services ranging from audit and tax compliance to M&A advisory and wealth management.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered accounting
- Tax compliance and planning
- CFO advisory services
- Audit and assurance
- Mergers and acquisitions
- Wealth management
- Family office services
- Outsourced accounting
- ERP implementation
- Deltek solutions
- High-net-worth individuals
- Estate planning
- Financial advisory
- Growth companies
- Technology-enabled solutions

## Core Services

- [Accounting & Tax Services](https://wiss.com/services): Wiss core services: audit, tax, advisory, wealth management
- [Expert Tax Solutions for Businesses & Individuals](https://wiss.com/service/tax): Wiss tax compliance, planning, and advisory for businesses and HNW
- [Audit and Assurance Services](https://wiss.com/service/audit-and-assurance): Wiss audit and assurance for financial reporting and compliance
- [Business Advisory Services & Consulting](https://wiss.com/service/advisory): Wiss advisory services for CFO support and process transformation
- [Outsourced Accounting Services](https://wiss.com/service/outsourcedaccounting): Wiss outsourced/co-sourced accounting with AI-powered solutions
- [Wealth Management and Family Office Service](https://wiss.com/service/wealth-management-and-family-office): Wiss wealth management and family office planning services
- [Mergers, Acquisitions and Valuation](https://wiss.com/service/mergers-acquisitions-and-valuation): Wiss M&A advisory, valuation, and due diligence services
